name: Event-D
source:
After years of planning, the first manned mission to colonize planet Mars is finally launched into space. But halfway through, the mission ends in tragedy in mysterious and inexplicable circumstances.

Claire, a candidate to command a future mission to Mars, dreams of leaving Earth behind and starting a new life on Mars, but her dreams are crushed when, due to the first mission tragedy, all other colonization missions are postponed indefinitely.

The Space Agency, desperate to find out what happened, decides to send a new mission to investigate the strange events, and Claire is appointed as commander of this new mission.

Thus, Claire and her crewmates leave for interplanetary space, in a journey into the unknown that will lead them to discover secrets that the universe kept hidden. Secrets that will force them to make decisions that will change forever the future of space exploration and humanity’s destiny.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/949670/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
经过多年的筹划，首次载人殖民火星任务终于发射到太空。但任务进行到一半时，却在神秘莫名的情况下以悲剧告终。

克莱尔是未来火星任务指挥员的候选人，她梦想着离开地球，在火星上开始新的生活，但由于第一次任务的悲剧，所有其他殖民任务都被无限期推迟，她的梦想破灭了。

航天局迫切想知道发生了什么，决定派出一个新的任务来调查这些奇怪的事件，克莱尔被任命为这个新任务的指挥官。

因此，克莱尔和她的船员们前往星际空间，踏上未知的旅程，带领他们发现宇宙隐藏的秘密。这些秘密将迫使他们做出决定，从而永远改变太空探索的未来和人类的命运。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/949670/]Steam[/url]]
